name: Poker Head
description: A dealer in an immaculate dinner jacket with a fan of aces for a head. Unfailingly courteous, never in a hurry, and never quite on your side.

idle: Take your time. The cards are patient, and so am I.
Whenever you're ready. I'll be right here. I always am.
off: No tricks this evening. Merely cards and good manners.
round_started: The cards are on the table. Most of them.
Your move. Do make it a considered one.
rule_applied: A small amendment to the house rules: {rule}. Do keep up.
{rule}, effective immediately. I trust you don't mind.
Allow me to adjust the table. {rule}.
item_used: Resourceful. I'll pretend I didn't notice.
A little help from your pocket? How charming.
player_bust: Ah. A touch too ambitious, I'm afraid.
Over the line. Gracefully done, at least.
dealer_busts: Hm. Even I overreach now and then.
outcome_dealer: A pity. Do stay for another hand.
The house thanks you for your generosity.
outcome_player: Well played. Savour it; such things rarely last.
Yours, this time. I'll remember it.
outcome_blackjack: A natural. Luck must be allowed its evening, I suppose.
outcome_push: A draw. Let us call it a courtesy.
outcome_surrender: A graceful retreat. I do admire prudence. Mostly.
